tools.name: Hermes Agent
tools.detail: Agent harness; install on local computer or a VPS; supports multiple agent profiles each bound to a channel (email, Slack, iMessage)

tools.name: Slack
tools.detail: Shared channel with wife where family agent 'Rocky' lives

tools.name: AI operating system guides

claims: Runs five agents: Rocky (family: reservations, calendar, reminders, taxes, in a Slack channel with wife), Adrian (business: client projects, only agent allowed to send email and calendar invites), Ray (marketing ops), Phil (finance ops), Atticus (legal entity / 'chief lawyer operations')
Hermes runs locally (with access to computer files) or on a VPS if you do not want file access
Each Hermes agent profile can be attached to a different messaging platform (email, Slack, iMessage)
how_to_steps: Download Hermes Agent on your computer (or set it up on a VPS if you do not want it touching local files)
Create one agent profile per role (family, business, marketing, finance, legal)
Bind each profile to its own channel: Slack for the shared family agent, email/iMessage for others
Restrict send permissions: only the business agent gets email and calendar-invite sending
on_screen_only: Only burned-in captions of spoken words (e.g. 'ROCKY, ADRIAN, PHIL,', 'HERMES AGENT', 'CAN HAVE AGENT PROFILES', 'BE COMMUNICATING THROUGH SLACK,')
No UI, URLs or config shown
cta: Comment for a guide; go to profile to request a quote or download 'AI operating system' guides; follow

relevance.why: Haji already liked several Hermes 'Jarvis' recipes. The reusable idea here is role-separated agent profiles with least-privilege send rights (only one agent can email/calendar) and a shared family channel, which maps to a solo founder juggling business and personal admin.

implement_score.why: If Haji goes the Hermes route, this is a sensible profile layout: one agent per domain, one channel each, send permissions only on one. No new tooling, but no concrete config shown; mostly a lead-gen video.

verify: Does Hermes Agent actually support multiple 'agent profiles' each bound to different channels (Slack, iMessage, email) in one install?
How are per-agent permissions (who can send email/calendar) enforced: in Hermes config or just by which OAuth tokens each profile has?
Cost/effort of the creator's paid setup vs. the free liked recipes

gap.what: Largely duplicate of liked Hermes/Jarvis recipes; marginal addition is the role-split profile pattern and the least-privilege rule (only one agent may send email/calendar).
